name: Shiyue Daotian Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shiyue Daotian Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pantry staple food in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through four segments: Rice Products; Corn Products; Whole Grain, Bean, and Other Products; and Dried Food and Other Products. The Rice Products segment produces pre-packaged rice products of different varieties, such as wuchang rice, daoxiang rice, long grain rice, and komachi rice. The Corn Products segment produces pre-packaged corn products, such as yellow, white, black, and multicolored glutinous corn, fruit corn, fruit corn kernels, flavored corn, as well as dried and peeled corn kernels.
